title: CogToM: A Comprehensive Theory of Mind Benchmark inspired by Human Cognition for Large Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It focused on Theory of Mind (ToM) capabilities, such as inferring mental states, emotions, beliefs, and intentions in social scenarios.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as its focus is on cognitive psychology and Theory of Mind.
